title: College ratings and matchup view corrected
items: Removed Matchday's under-supported power rating from the college conference tables and replaced it with the imported analytical ranking context; teams outside its coverage show unavailable rather than a fabricated number.
Aligned conference-table columns and used the imported rating only to break tied preseason records.
Made the imported snapshots update the visible freshness timestamp instead of showing seven-day-old provider data.
Removed Pregame Context from expanded matchups and refreshed the expanded analysis layout.
